verdict.rationale: Ramp documents its own data-extraction paths. Admins can "pull full spend exports" through Ramp MCP, and the Developer API (an OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, including transactions) returns transaction data. The open-source CLI emits JSON in agent mode, and accounting sync pushes transactions, reimbursements, bills and related records to QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero. None of this is documented as a complete, account-wide export in a stated open format, and nothing covers offboarding. Missing for 10: a documented one-step export of all account data, explicitly stated open export formats (e.g. CSV or JSON bulk dumps), coverage beyond spend data such as receipts, attachments, audit logs and policies, account closure or offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
